title: Roman Soldiers
summary: Roman soldiers enforced imperial order, guarded prisoners, carried out punishments, and appeared throughout the passion and Acts narratives.
background: Soldiers show the visible presence of Rome in the land. They could be involved in crucifixion, imprisonment, protection, or travel under guard.
teachingHelp: When soldiers appear, notice how earthly power serves God’s purposes even when it acts unjustly or unknowingly.
